chunks: One of his companions replied to him with a long speech, in which he praised him much and mentioned his listening and obedience.
Whereupon he (peace be upon him) said:
ai.seo_question: How did the companion of Imam Ali respond to his question in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this episode from *Nahj al-Balagha*, a companion offers a lengthy, somewhat verbose praise to Imam Ali (AS), highlighting his own attentiveness and obedience. The Imam’s response serves as a subtle critique of excessive flattery and self-praise, emphasizing that true leadership requires humility and that the ruler’s authority is a trust rather than a status to be celebrated through mutual acclaim. This interaction underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the balance between respect for the Imam and the avoidance of ostentatious devotion.

en.sayed-ali-raza: One of Amīr al-mu’minīn’s companions replied to him by a long speech wherein he praised him much and mentioned his own listening to him and obeying him,
